_scenario.title: River camera has gone quiet (online file running)
_scenario.description: TouchDesigner is running the online show file (river-online-oct-20.toe), the one that uses the live river camera and Dave's agent, so the seasons page isn't served (fetch failed: connection refused on 9981; td.seasons is null): expected for this file. The fault: the river camera's RTSP port still accepts TCP connections (devices.river_cam true) but sends no frames. TD's relay reports its last frame 1800 s ago and fresh false (river_cam.py never records a stream error, so error stays null while the relay keeps restarting ffmpeg); the panels and ropes have fallen back to the rain. The Modal link's river capture is in the same state: its last successful clip (the last INFO line) was at 01:58, an hour ago, and every clip since has failed with an ERROR line about 70 s apart, so the log file itself is still fresh (log_age_s small). The recorder's current run times out. The cached river still is 30 minutes old.

expect.headline: The river camera has sent no frames for 30 minutes: the show is running on the rain fallback (online file)

expect.action: Reboot the river camera through its API from bitcube, or wait for the Starlink link to settle. If the live river isn't needed tonight, Switch now to the seasons file, which doesn't use it.
